name: quickbooks
description: Reads QuickBooks Online customers, invoices, payments, accounts, and vendors through the v3 Query API via the OAuth 2.0 refresh-token grant; tracks the complete r2 official qbo operation ledger with non-stream operations blocked by default.

risk.read: external QuickBooks Online v3 Query API read of customer/invoice/payment/account/vendor entities
risk.approval: read streams require no write approval; official write, binary, provider-query, and CDC ledger rows remain blocked until typed schemas, bounds, redaction, fixtures, and plan -> preview -> approval -> execute evidence exist

conformance.reason: custom-auth-only (mode:custom AuthHook, no when-gated non-custom fallback) AND every executable stream is StreamHook-handled (QuickBooks' STARTPOSITION/MAXRESULTS pagination state is embedded inside a single Query-API 'query' string value, which the declarative page_number/offset_limit paginators cannot express independently); hook-covered, proven by archived parity evidence for quickbooks and internal/connectors/hooks/quickbooks/hooks_test.go. The complete official operation ledger is metadata-only beyond the five read streams; conformance's synthetic config has no real token_url and cannot exercise mode:custom auth, so every auth-resolving dynamic read/write check would otherwise fail identically and uninformatively
